profile.summary: TeachFX is a company that makes an instructional coaching platform for teachers. Teachers record their lessons as audio, and the software analyzes classroom talk patterns, such as student participation and open-ended questions, to give feedback. School and district leaders can use it to track instructional improvement across schools.

review.notes: TeachFX, Inc. at 83 Nevada St, Redwood City matches the agenda name and city, and the classroom-audio coaching product fits an Educator Effectiveness-funded academic services agreement. The cited Terms of Service list legal@teachfx.com, not support@teachfx.com, so the email is unsupported; the summary is supported and neutral.
